passages.note: Printed pp. 33–35 describe the 1955 NPL apparatus with an elongated cavity providing two separated interactions, identify it as Ramsey’s method developed in 1949, and describe a Marconi quartz oscillator. The history establishes use of the method, not consultation of a particular printed publication.
